story.act.monument.after: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is earned, not issued.
story.act.monument.why: T1 V2.10: flat procedural put-down; goal kept

story.tale.monument.A1.after: Fresh off the factory floor, you're ready to do some damage to yourself. Make your engineers proud.

story.tale.monument.B1.after: Battery 1 is fitted. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch you dash into a colleague.
story.tale.monument.B1.why: kept: skybridge joke already dry; Battery 1, dash, place

story.tale.monument.C1.after: The LED drum lights each bend. Step off the high road onto a car: gravity is company policy.
story.tale.monument.C1.why: kept: 'gravity is company policy' is the target register

story.tale.monument.C2.after: The road runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. Take your write-off up there; ignore the view.
story.tale.monument.C2.why: kept: 'ignore the view' already a flat put-down

story.tale.monument.B2.after: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Stand near it until a colleague finds you.
story.tale.monument.B2.why: kept: ZERO ACCIDENTS exact; duty matches struck

story.tale.monument.A2.after: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.
story.tale.monument.A2.why: kept: place, Hands 1, cone duty; deadpan

story.tale.monument.A3.after: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Build the same way: one hit, then another, quickly.
story.tale.monument.A3.why: kept: place turned to the combo; deadpan

story.tale.monument.B3.after: Two screens advertise to each other; neither advertises you yet. Legs 1 is fitted: jump into a passing car.
story.tale.monument.B3.why: T14: 'jump into a car' in four lines; dry put-down, place and Legs 1 kept

story.tale.monument.C3.after: The gateway thanked the car that wrote you off for driving safely. Let one colleague throw you into the next.
story.tale.monument.C3.why: kept: gateway's thanks is the dry joke; bounce duty

story.act.parkland.after: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.
story.act.parkland.why: kept: states service to clients; motivates

story.tale.parkland.C1.after: The lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit for clients. With Arms 1, push off one car into the next.

story.tale.parkland.C2.after: Our board watches opening day from these terraces. A van delivers the catering; arrange for it to deliver you.
story.tale.parkland.C2.why: kept: catering van joke lands; board, not clients, watches

story.tale.parkland.C3.after: The arch is the Expo's gate; visitors circle the roundabout once. You go faster: chain hits before each is forgotten.
story.tale.parkland.C3.why: kept: 'before each is forgotten' already dry

story.tale.parkland.B3.after: The obelisk marks the surveyors' first stake. Police escort a school party here on opening day; test the escort first.
story.tale.parkland.B3.why: R5: 'them' could read as the school party; the police are the brief

story.tale.parkland.A3.after: A wedding faces the traffic from the belvedere. Legs 2 is fitted: jump into a car, so no guest does.
story.tale.parkland.A3.why: kept: 'so no guest does' is service, deadpan

story.tale.parkland.A2.after: The dome is the Expo's showroom; you are the exhibit. Hands 2 is fitted: bait a car with a cone.
story.tale.parkland.A2.why: kept: 'you are the exhibit' already the put-down

story.tale.parkland.A1.after: The gardener's pools need cars that stop. Teach them with Arms 2: push off one car into the next.
story.tale.parkland.A1.why: kept: gardener's pools, Arms 2, push duty

story.tale.parkland.B1.after: The cascade was built to drown out the traffic. The traffic got louder; take your hit up on the highway.
story.tale.parkland.B1.why: kept: cascade joke already dry; raised road duty

story.tale.parkland.B2.after: The board watches the ring over the pools and applauds the cars. Battery 2 is fitted: chain your hits.
story.tale.parkland.B2.why: Canon row 520: board applauds the cars at B2; praise withheld (T16)

story.act.waterfront.after: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared, provisionally.
story.act.waterfront.why: T1 V2.10: asset under review; sacrifice stated plainly (V10)

story.tale.waterfront.A1.after: The bus carries engineers through the west portal to the bridge. It never misses; take its hit.
story.tale.waterfront.A1.why: kept: 'it never misses' flat; bus duty

story.tale.waterfront.B1.after: Cars go into the tunnel under the hill, and data comes back. Legs 3 is fitted: leap into one.
story.tale.waterfront.B1.why: kept: tunnel and data; Legs 3, jump

story.tale.waterfront.C1.after: The east portal faces away from its twin. Police here check papers; your Certification needs their fleet on record.
story.tale.waterfront.C1.why: kept: east portal, police duty, Certification goal

story.tale.waterfront.C2.after: The east beach terrace served tourists, then sensors. Drop from its rail onto a car; ships wait for the Certified.
story.tale.waterfront.C2.why: kept: terrace detail; drop duty; ships motivate

story.tale.waterfront.C3.after: The pier tower logs all that floats: containers, ducks, one dummy. Be thrown into a car to earn your entry.
story.tale.waterfront.C3.why: kept: 'one dummy' in the log is the put-down

story.tale.waterfront.B3.after: The stilt houses keep Chassis 0 behind glass. Arms 3 is fitted; push off a car and show it progress.
story.tale.waterfront.B3.why: kept: Chassis 0 canon; Arms 3, push duty

story.tale.waterfront.A3.after: The west tower keeps the customs log. Your entry reads PURPOSE DESTRUCTION: honour it on the raised road.
story.tale.waterfront.A3.why: kept: customs log canon; raised road duty

story.tale.waterfront.A2.after: Sand from three provinces lies under the west beach terrace. Place a cone; one more clean reading before the ceremony.
story.tale.waterfront.A2.why: kept: west beach terrace; cone duty; ceremony

story.tale.waterfront.B2.after: The circus monument, cast from your written-off chassis, reads ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS). Battery 3 is fitted; chain your hits.
story.tale.waterfront.B2.why: kept: ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS) exact; Battery 3

story.brief.any.after: Walk into the path of the incoming vehicles. Time your approach, and choose your angle carefully. Bonus points for combinations and lethal hits.

story.brief.dash.after: Dash into a car. Only a dash counts as the final hit.
story.brief.dash.why: T14: 'the final hit must' in seven briefs

story.brief.drop.after: Drop onto a car from above. Your last hit must be that drop.
story.brief.drop.why: T14: 'the final hit must' in seven briefs

story.brief.jump.after: Jump into traffic. The jump must be the final hit.
story.brief.jump.why: T14: 'jump into a car' in four lines

story.brief.level.after: Climb to a raised road. Write off the chassis up there, not on the street.
story.brief.level.why: T14: 'the final hit must'; glossary write-off

story.brief.cone.after: Place a cone to bait a car. The car that reacts must deliver the final hit.
story.brief.cone.why: T14; names the bait, as Lawrence's cone line does

story.brief.push.after: Push off from one car into another. The second car delivers the final hit.
story.brief.push.why: T14: 'push off one car', 'the final hit must' repeated

story.brief.bounce.after: Let one car throw you into another. Take the final hit while a hit is still throwing you.
story.brief.bounce.why: kept: imperative goal, then the final hit; varied phrasing

story.brief.struck.after: Walk or stand in the traffic. A car must deliver the final hit while you are not dashing.
story.brief.struck.why: kept: imperative goal, then the final hit

story.brief.combo.after: Chain your hits into a combo. The final hit must be link {n} or later.
story.brief.combo.why: kept: goal and {n} intact; one of two 'final hit must'

story.brief.cls.after: Step in front of the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.
story.brief.cls.why: kept: 'a {cls}' feeds the article fix in taskText

story.ending.after: Your model has passed, adequately, and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.
story.ending.why: T16: praise withheld; 'adequately' is the amendment's own register

notice.n01.after: You are a Dummy Corporation trainee. Each write-off is logged and reviewed; make it worth the paperwork.
notice.n01.why: T14: slogan in two notices; Arcade has no Certification; asset under review

notice.n02.after: Welcome, trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notice.n02.why: kept: title line; slogan now in one notice only

notice.n03.after: Get your Dummy Certification in Shenzhen Smart City and learn about the Corporation.

notice.n13.after: A Corporation drone brings this part.

notice.n14.after: A Corporation drone brings this part. Delivery follows results; keep training.
notice.n14.why: T14: 'a Corporation drone brings' in four lines; dry nudge

notice.n15.after: Not for sale. Reach its tile; a drone delivers it.
notice.n15.why: T15: denial gets a put-down, then the fix; T14

notice.n16.after: Not fitted yet; the drone brings it
notice.n16.why: T14: 'a Corporation drone brings' in four lines; form kept

notice.n17.after: Chassis in the river; drone dispatched. Cars do not swim.
notice.n17.why: T16: one put-down in the three drone lines

notice.n18.after: Corporation drone dispatched. Obstruction will be relocated.
notice.n18.why: kept: 'Obstruction will be relocated' already deadpan

notice.n19.after: Corporation drone: chassis recovered from the river

notice.n20.after: Training complete. The Corporation thanks you for your service.

notice.n21.after: Traffic exhausted. Results insufficient; report to the bay.
notice.n21.why: T15: a miss gets a two-word put-down, then the order

notice.n24.after: Neon shops, LED walls; one road splits round the monument under the walkway ring. Your training begins here.
notice.n24.why: kept: district blurb names its place

notice.n25.after: Water and concrete; a boulevard passes under the raised ring. Your write-offs open the Expo to clients.
notice.n25.why: kept: district blurb; service to clients

notice.n26.after: A hill walled by towers; bridges cross the drive and the river. Certified dummies ship across it to clients.
notice.n26.why: kept: district blurb; Certified ship to clients

notice.n27.why: kept: label; district not in play

notice.n28.after: Towers and barriers. Corporation Tower stands over your training.

notice.n29.after: The test centre the city was modelled on. Hits on its impact plates count for more.

notice.n30.after: Two flyovers cross it, one above the other. Corporation Tower stands at the centre; towers shade your training.

notice.n31.after: Impact plates mark the road at the centre. A write-off on a plate counts for more.

notice.n32.why: kept: label; district not in play

notice.n33.why: kept: label; district not in play

notice.n34.after: Get hit in fun, creative, and destructive ways before the vehicles run out.

notice.n36.after: Self-driving cars are designed never to hit anyone. Your training: get hit, in combos, and earn your parts.
notice.n36.why: kept: states the training plainly; motivates

notice.n37.after: Write off bodies; every {Q} write-offs, the grade rises. Keep training until the vehicles run out.
